clue.text: Academic protecting old mathematical work

indicators.note: the academic wraps around and so shields the other piece

parts.note: a prof is a professor, an academic

explanation.surface: A professor guards an old piece of mathematics.
explanation.definitionFit: A proof is the worked demonstration of a theorem in mathematics.

clue.text: Chap who loves spare ribs?

parts.note: Eve was made from Adam's rib, so a rib is a wife, and spare ones are extra wives

explanation.definitionFit: A man with several wives at once is a polygamist; the ribs are wives after Eve.

clue.text: A way to escape abroad

definitions.meaning: an exit or way ... of a situation

explanation.definitionFit: An out is a means of escape, and out also means away or abroad.

clue.text: Wily barber raised soldier in card game

parts.note: faro is an old gambling card game

indicators.note: in a down entry the soldier is turned upwards

parts.note: a GI is an American soldier

explanation.surface: A soldier lifted in a card game.
explanation.definitionFit: Figaro is the cunning barber of Seville in Beaumarchais, Rossini and Mozart.

clue.text: Good result —- gold for one of the following people

parts.note: a success is a good outcome
or is gold in heraldry

explanation.surface: A fine outcome earns gold for someone coming next in line.
explanation.definitionFit: A successor is a person who follows another in a role or position.

clue.text: Will part from naval vessel on lake in grounds

parts.note: a sub is a submarine

indicators.note: the lake goes inside the grounds

parts.note: a cause means grounds or reason

explanation.definitionFit: A will is divided into clauses, and a subclause is a subsidiary part of one.

clue.text: Noblewoman losing two pieces, initially, in board game

indicators.note: the first two letters are dropped from the front

parts.note: a duchess is a noblewoman

explanation.surface: A duchess loses two pieces early in a board game.
explanation.definitionFit: Chess is the classic board game of strategy.

clue.text: Greedy rebel coming up with promises of settlement

indicators.note: in a down entry the rebel's name reads upwards

parts.note: Jack Cade led a rebellion in 1450
IOUs are written promises to pay a debt

explanation.surface: A greedy insurgent turns up waving promissory notes.
explanation.definitionFit: Edacious is a learned word for voracious, devouring, greedy.

clue.text: Infestation disrupted group of players

indicators.note: the word is broken up and rearranged

explanation.surface: A pest outbreak upsets a band of musicians.
explanation.definitionFit: A sinfonietta is a small orchestra, a group of musical players.

clue.text: Like a bunch unaffected by nominal changes, optimistic

definitions.text: Like a bunch unaffected by nominal changes
definitions.meaning: like a rose, which would smell as sweet by any other name

explanation.definitionFit: Rosy means like a rose, recalling Juliet's line, and also hopeful as in a rosy outlook.

clue.text: Set fire to one part of building, resulting in legal case, possibly

parts.note: lit means set fire to
I is the Roman numeral one
a gable is the triangular end wall of a building

explanation.surface: Arson on part of a building may end up in court.
explanation.definitionFit: Something litigable can be taken to law, so it may possibly result in a legal case.

clue.text: David's second wife has name in Times

indicators.note: the name sits within the times

parts.note: ages means long times or eras

explanation.surface: A man's second marriage partner gets her name in the newspaper.
explanation.walkthrough: David is Dickens's David Copperfield, whose second wife is Agnes Wickfield.
explanation.definitionFit: Agnes Wickfield marries David Copperfield after his first wife Dora dies, in the Dickens novel.

clue.text: Order seems original for supreme commander

indicators.note: to order is to arrange, so the letters of the next two words are put in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A command looks novel coming from the top general.
explanation.definitionFit: A generalissimo is the commander-in-chief over all armed forces, a supreme military leader.

clue.text: Prophet with no great instrument and a limited form of music

parts.note: taken as written
a Strad is a Stradivarius violin

indicators.note: the word is cut short at its end

parts.note: the word music, before shortening

explanation.surface: A seer without a fine violin and only a little music.
explanation.definitionFit: Nostradamus was the sixteenth-century French seer famous for prophecies.

clue.text: One way to make gains from siege

definitions.meaning: putting money into something for profit
an old military sense, the surrounding of a town

explanation.definitionFit: Investment is putting money in for return, and also the besieging of a place.

clue.text: Service for state, in short

definitions.meaning: a church service, the Eucharist in Catholic use
the shortened form of Massachusetts, a US state

explanation.definitionFit: Mass is the Catholic Eucharistic service, and the state's abbreviation is its short form.

clue.text: Are you said to cut short this activity for hooligans?

definitions.text: Are you said to cut short this activity for hooligans?

parts.words: Are you said to cut short this activity for hooligans?
parts.note: the letters R and U, spoken, sound like 'are you', and RU is the usual short form of the sport; the hooligans recall the saying that it is a hooligans' game played by gentlemen

explanation.surface: A question about curtailing some rowdy pastime.
explanation.walkthrough: An old British saying contrasts football, a gentlemen's game played by hooligans, with this code, a hooligans' game played by gentlemen.
explanation.definitionFit: The fifteen-a-side code of rugby is abbreviated RU and proverbially a game for hooligans.

clue.text: Withdraw from sudden attack, split apart

definitions.meaning: to leave a group or party

explanation.definitionFit: To break away is to withdraw; a breakaway is a sudden attack.

clue.text: Six and ten get interchanged, by way of illustration

parts.note: VI is six in Roman numerals

indicators.note: the letters of these two words swap places to make a new order

explanation.surface: Numbers swap places as an example.
explanation.definitionFit: A vignette is a small decorative illustration or sketch.

clue.text: In financial distress, but no longer crooked, we hear

indicators.note: this tells the solver the word is identified by how it is spoken

parts.note: straightened means made straight, no longer bent

explanation.surface: A reformed criminal, now going straight, is broke.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in straitened circumstances means being short of money.

clue.text: Problem with lid English put on pen

indicators.note: in an across entry the English is added after the pen

parts.note: a sty is a pen for pigs

explanation.surface: An English writer has trouble with the top of a pen.
explanation.definitionFit: A stye is an inflamed swelling on the eyelid, a problem affecting the lid.

clue.text: Instigate prison rising

parts.note: stir is slang for prison
up means rising or ascending

explanation.surface: Fomenting an uprising in jail.
explanation.definitionFit: To stir up trouble is to instigate it.

clue.text: Study evaluates characteristic area between oceans

parts.note: a den is a private study room
marks means grades or evaluates work
a trait is a characteristic

explanation.surface: Research appraises a distinctive feature of some region.
explanation.definitionFit: The Denmark Strait is the channel between Greenland and Iceland linking the Atlantic and Arctic Oceans.

clue.text: Finally cut world record?

indicators.note: the phrase loses its last letter

parts.note: at last means finally

explanation.definitionFit: An atlas is a book of maps recording the world.

clue.text: Conservative politician embracing a doctrinaire group

parts.note: an MP is a Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: A Tory MP hugs a dogmatic faction.
explanation.definitionFit: A camp is a faction holding a shared, often rigid, set of views.

clue.text: Allow daughter into a college

indicators.note: the daughter goes inside the a-and-college pair

parts.note: MIT is the Massachusetts Institute of Technology

explanation.surface: Letting one's daughter into a college.
explanation.definitionFit: To admit someone is to allow them entry.

clue.text: Unlike sentence, initially inappropriate in High Court?

definitions.meaning: a sentence starts with a capital letter, so small letters are unlike its start
a case for a lesser court, not suited to the High Court

explanation.surface: A judge's sentence that starts out unsuitable for the High Court.
explanation.definitionFit: Lower-case letters are the small ones, and a lower case would be a matter for an inferior court.

clue.text: Everyone said it's meant to be boring

indicators.note: this tells the solver the word is identified by its sound

parts.note: all means everyone

explanation.surface: Everybody said it is supposed to be dull.
explanation.definitionFit: An awl is a pointed tool for boring holes.

clue.text: People not stopping old-fashioned extremes in religious body

indicators.note: the outside letters of each of the next two words are taken

clue.text: Trial of one involved in secret scheme
